title: Magnitude
summary: MAG'NITUDE, noun [Latin magnitudo.] Extent of dimensions or parts; bulk; size; applied to things that have length, breadth or thickness. 1. Greatness; grandeur. With plain heroic magnitude of mind. 2.

inlines.v: MAG'NITUDE, noun [Latin magnitudo.] Extent of dimensions or parts; bulk; size; applied to things that have length, breadth or thickness. 1. Greatness; grandeur. With plain heroic magnitude of mind. 2. Greatness, in reference to influence or effect; importance. In affairs or magnitude disdain not to take counsel.
